def solve(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    o=[r[:] for r in g]
    for j in range(w):
        if g[h-1][j]:
            seeds=[(i,g[i][j]) for i in range(h) if g[i][j]]
            prev=-1
            for i,v in seeds:
                for r in range(prev+1,i+1): o[r][j]=v
                prev=i
    return o
